scope: Verified v0 development subset; not stable-v1 or full protocol/target certification.

required_gates.completion_condition: Freeze selected support, exclusions, external evidence and all24 completion conditions.
Review changes since core rc.2 and retain exact Linux/Windows API snapshot; no Go source change in this release batch.
Seven checkout suites pass for the exact commit selected for the core tag.
Publish immutable core tag, verify remote commit, authenticated download and independent core-only cold consumer.
Pin adapter to the already published core; generate real sums and pass GOWORK=off installed-core pure/race/vet/API checks.
Seven checkout suites pass for the exact commit selected for the adapter tag.
Publish the separate immutable adapter tag and verify its commit.
Both independently empty-cache consumers pass exact graph/API/source/checksum/pure/race/native checks without replace.
Published-install workflow passes for the exact new core/adapter pair with artifact validation.
Publish final commits/checksums/CI/install receipts and current English installation/migration guidance.

explicitly_unsupported: Full SCUR/PRICE_ENQUIRY, S6a, full standalone RFC8506 behavior and unselected deep protocol subsets.
Full Sh XSD/data model and internationalization; transparent User-Data is not semantic support.
DRA/relay product, MAP/SIP/TPDU engine, charging/accounting service, business retry scheduler or library persistence.
Persistent exactly-once, unapproved recovery, automatic cross-target authorization or universal six-template replacement.
Native SCTP on Windows/386; arm64 cross-build evidence is not native runtime acceptance; SCTP DTLS is not enabled.
Ordinary no-IMSI success SRA, unreviewed Realm/time-equality construction and restricted standard SMS failure/sequence or experimental5011 generation branches.
Automatic diagnostic mapping for unreviewed ambiguous/mixed conditions; safe-close/unsupported boundaries remain.
Production throughput/latency/capacity, long-soak, multi-tenant fairness or mixed-transport guarantees from finite tests.

required: Original six-template inputs/outputs and deployed versions
Durable intent, old-worker fencing and unknown-result reconciliation
Direct normative or named compatibility evidence for restricted result/identity/Realm/time combinations
